verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe skills as reusable folders of markdown instructions, scripts and resources for the agent. User-invocable skills appear as `/<skill-name>` slash commands, a Marketplace tab installs plugins from configured sources, and `grok inspect` reports which skills were discovered. That covers equipping the agent with custom skills for specialized tasks. Missing for 10: authoring details (skill file location and format, how the agent selects skills automatically) and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work.
